'''Kyera Termendal''' was a [[Shiota]]n poet who lived between {{fy|700}} and {{fy|800}}.
== History ==
Some time between {{fy|700}} and {{fy|800}}, Kyera published a disputed translation of "[[Prophecies of the Dragon]]".{{ref/book|7|Prologue}}
